name: Qubes
author: achevalier-dev
description: Qubes-style compartments in the Omarchy bar: which qubes run, in which colour, and the actions to start, stop and open apps in them.

barWidget.description: Running qubes as coloured dots next to a cube glyph. The panel lists every qube with its label, and opens a terminal, an app, or a disposable.

schema.label: Refresh interval
schema.description: How often to ask `qube list` what is running. The call is local and cheap.
